rows.controlled-player-plays-the-chosen-card-: Oracle: the controlled player plays the chosen card if able (CR 723.2, 723.5a, 723.7, 701.18b). Observed in gorge: p0 chose Grizzly Bears from p1's hand, p1 was offered 'Play Grizzly Bears' and the answer was taken, but the Bears never left p1's hand and p1's Forests stayed untapped. Corroboration: XMage (4142596) and a strict Forge (driver f8e1f161c37a = b33362f600 + controlled-player mana) run of this scenario both play the Bears for p1 with p1's own lands: the driver pays the controlled player's {1}{G} from p1's two Forests, so both Forests are tapped, the Bears are on p1's battlefield and the Mountain stays in hand, agreeing with the Oracle text. Both engines therefore diverge from gorge.
